labeling_note: Model-agnostic memory layer; vector-store and prompt risks are applicable, but project-owned datasets/models are not.

criteria.rationale: Python dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml.
poetry.lock and a server docker-compose file pin the environment.
mem0 is a memory layer, not a project-owned dataset workflow.
The framework supports many model providers and does not own a model card.
Apache-2.0 applies to the code; no project-owned model license is involved.
The repository provides tests and evaluation tooling for executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the memory framework.
Tests, CI and Make targets provide reproducible verification commands.
Prompt code exists, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
Some generation/retrieval parameters appear in server code, but no complete sampling configuration is documented.
Retrieval and vector stores are core, but index/embedding versions are not recorded.
Agent mentions are integrations; mem0 is not itself an agent trace system.
Benchmarks are mentioned, but data splits and contamination analysis are not documented.
Cost is mentioned as a benefit, but no reproducible cost or latency measurement is provided.
